runtime: CUDA sm_120 / clock64 / ld.global.cg.u32 / one-warp blocks

device.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU

semantics: Each one-warp block runs 32 lane-local, strictly dependent pointer chains. clock64 exposes per-thread elapsed SM cycles including scheduling. CUDA events expose total kernel throughput. ld.global.cg bypasses L1 and requests the L2/global path. Cold follows L2 eviction; hot immediately repeats the same seeds and chains.
